macros.name: xintFirstItem
macros.doc: \xintFirstItem{ ⟨list⟩ } returns the first item of its argument, one pair of braces removed.

macros.name: xintFirstOne
macros.doc: \xintFirstOne{ ⟨list⟩ } returns the first item as a braced item. i.e. if it was braced the braces are kept, else the braces are added.

macros.name: xintLastItem
macros.doc: \xintLastItem{ ⟨list⟩ } returns the last item of its argument, one pair of braces removed.

macros.name: xintLastOne
macros.doc: \xintLastOne{ ⟨list⟩ } returns the last item as a braced item. i.e. if it was braced the braces are kept, else the braces are added.

macros.name: xintReverseOrder
macros.doc: \xintReverseOrder{ ⟨list⟩ } does not do any expansion of its argument and just reverses the order of the tokens in the ⟨list⟩ .

macros.name: xintverbosetrue
macros.doc: After issuing \xintverbosetrue the values of defined variables are written out to the log (and terminal).
